bio:
Bobby is a skilled Senior Analytics Specialist at FinMark Trust, with extensive experience in survey management and data analytics spanning over 11 years. He was involved in the different processes of the design and implementation of projects within the Data4FI (data for financial inclusion) and measurement work streams for the insight2impact programme. In his role, Bobby has produced, implemented and communicated new analytical tools that practitioners can adapt and implement in their own countries. His expertise includes research design, analysis and project management.

Prior to joining the organisation, Bobby was an account manager with a global marketing research company. He holds an honours degree in economics and a social sciences degree in philosophy, politics and economics.
name: Bobby Berkowitz
